scheme_name: PM Vidyalaxmi (education loan with collateral-free guarantee)
aliases: PM Vidyalaxmi scheme education loan; collateral free loan students 2024
nodal_ministry: Ministry of Education (Department of Higher Education)
implementing_agency: Banks/financial institutions with the Credit Guarantee Fund for Education Loans (CGFSEL) and the Vidya Lakshmi portal
scheme_type: Central Sector Scheme (credit guarantee + interest subvention)
launched_year: Announced in Union Budget 2024-25; guidelines notified in November 2024
target_groups: Students admitted to higher education institutions ranked in the top 860 NIRF institutions, including SC/ST students from low-income families
age_criteria: As per bank norms
income_limit: Family annual income up to Rs 8,00,000 (for the collateral-free guarantee and 3% interest subvention components)
other_eligibility: Admission to a recognised institution (as notified); loan through the Vidya Lakshmi portal; for collateral-free loans up to Rs 7.5 lakh, the guarantee is provided under CGFSEL; for loans up to Rs 10 lakh with full collateral-free cover under specific conditions; interest subvention for income up to Rs 4.5 lakh during the moratorium
exclusions: Institutions/students outside the notified list; benefit cannot be combined with certain other loan-linked subsidies
benefits_summary: Collateral-free education loan with a Government guarantee, plus interest subvention during the study/moratorium period for low-income families - removing the need for family assets as security
benefit_types: Education loan; Credit guarantee; Interest subvention
benefit_amount: Collateral-free education loans with 75% guarantee cover by the Government for loans up to Rs 7.5 lakh; 90% cover for top-250 NIRF institutions; 3% interest subvention during moratorium for family income up to Rs 4.5 lakh (Central-sector students)
funding_pattern: 100% Central (guarantee fund + subvention)
interest_rate: As per the bank's education-loan rate; reduced by 3% subvention during the moratorium for eligible families
repayment: As per bank education-loan norms (moratorium during course plus typically 1 year, then 10-15 years)
coverage: About 7 lakh students expected to benefit every year; total outlay of about Rs 3,600 crore for 2024-25 to 2031-32
application_mode: Apply through the Vidya Lakshmi portal (single window for education loans)
documents_required: Admission letter; fee structure; income certificate; caste certificate where applicable; Aadhaar; bank statements; co-borrower/guarantor details as applicable
helpline: Vidya Lakshmi portal helpdesk; bank education-loan desks
key_features: Removes the collateral requirement that blocked SC/ST students from education loans; launched in 2024 and therefore the newest major student-benefit scheme; complements Post-Matric Scholarships for students above income ceilings
recent_updates: Guidelines issued November 2024; banks onboarding through Vidya Lakshmi; expansion of eligible-institution list and awareness drives in 2025-26

scheme_name: Bihar Student Credit Card Scheme
aliases: Bihar student credit card loan amount; education loan Bihar students
nodal_ministry: Education Department, Government of Bihar (with the Planning and Development Department)
implementing_agency: DRCC/district officials with the State's single-window portal
target_groups: Students of Bihar, including SC/ST students, pursuing higher education after Class 12
age_criteria: Up to 25 years
income_limit: No family income ceiling for the scheme
other_eligibility: Bihar resident; passed Class 12; admission to a recognised higher-education course (general, technical or professional) in Bihar or outside; not a defaulter
exclusions: Only one loan per student; course must be recognised; repayment responsibility shared between the student and the State
benefits_summary: Education loan on easy terms with the State paying interest during the study period and offering repayment support, so that no student is denied education for want of money
benefit_amount: Loan up to Rs 4,00,000 per student for tuition and other expenses; simple interest of about 4% per annum; 50% of the interest paid by the State; if the loan and interest are repaid on time, the State pays half of the principal back; repayment over 7 years after the moratorium
funding_pattern: State Government (interest support and repayment incentive) with bank credit
interest_rate: About 4% per annum simple interest, of which the State pays 50%
repayment: After course completion plus a moratorium; 7-year repayment window with a State incentive of half the principal on timely repayment
coverage: Over 1 lakh students have benefited since 2016-17
application_mode: Online application through the State's Student Credit Card portal, then district-level processing
application_portal: https://www.7nishchayyuvaup.gov.in / Bihar Student Credit Card portal
documents_required: Class 12 marksheet; admission letter/fee structure; Aadhaar; residence proof; bank account; caste certificate for SC/ST records; photographs
helpline: Bihar Student Credit Card helpline; DRCC district offices
key_features: State-backed education loan with interest subsidy and principal repayment incentive; open to all categories with no income ceiling - particularly useful for SC/ST students above scholarship income limits; one of the most successful state education-loan models
recent_updates: Not specified
